plugin.notes: 2.8.0: with the Worker relay (after Update relay to 1.3.0), every phone you pair gets its own key: the panel lists your phones (name, connected now, last seen) and removes one phone from the relay without touching the others. 2.7.x: the plugin reads none of Orca's private files; relay redeploys only on click unless you opt in.

relay.notes: Relay 1.3.0: per-phone keys. Each phone pairs on its own address, so the desktop can list phones and remove one at a time; the shared address older phones use can be blocked. Update keeps your phones paired.
